source.note: Archive C2HS2-12-06-18_05E3CMT.ABS.zip from the Openbox / Openbox S10 directory on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-11-07.

simulator.note: Boots as a single-CPU M3602 board (chips/m3602.py, run_dump_openbox_s10_app_starts.py): the bootloader ("SMT---1.0.0") probes DDR at 0xA800AA68, unpacks maincode ("SMT 1.0.0", 5.88 MB) to 0x80000200 and starts the application, which prints "APP  init ok" on UART, configures its external ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33 and tuner at I2C 0x60 on SCB0, and issues graphics engine commands at 0xB800A000 and 0xB800C000.

desc: Openbox S10 HD PVR firmware C2HS2-12-06-18:05E3CMT (2012-06-20) for the single-CPU ALi M3602 DVB-S2 satellite PVR receiver with 4 MB SPI flash.
Uses "SMT---1.0.0" / "SMT 1.0.0" chunk versions without a separate seecode image, an external ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33 on SCB0, and a DVB-S2 tuner at I2C 0x60.
